regions.merged_text: I received your welcome letter of the 20th a few days ago. I would ask now what I should do with regards to books, clothes, etc, as also when your scholastic year begins. I suppose you were informed about my bill of $525.00 at St. Francis'. What should I do about that before I go to join you? - supposing I could not pay cash.
